Name: Content Patcher Spice Berry Crop
Author: tinkeringbell
Description:
Adds Spice Berry seeds to the Island Trader shop for 1000g per packet.
These seeds can be planted in summer, take 10 days to mature and regrow every 3 days, and produce a single Spice Berry per plant, per harvest. 

They're mostly the top of a coffee plant on a stick, and just my way of making sure I can have regrowable fruit crops for every color needed for Qi's Prismatic Grange Quest.

Downloads.Description: Zip file containing the Content Patcher pack that adds a regrowing Spice Berry crop.
